# Geopolitical & Macroeconomic Vector Engine — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Macroeconomic simulation framework modeling international trade flows, supply-chain bottlenecks, currency valuation, and diplomatic state transitions using Nash equilibrium principles.

## Project Identification
- Name: Politic Sim (politic_sim)
- Creator: Jirnyak (https://github.com/Jirnyak)
- Co-Architect & Contributor: Adolf Petushkov (https://github.com/marko1olo)
- Live Showcase: https://jirnyak.github.io/politic_sim/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Jirnyak/politic_sim
